fittrack-mobile.title: FitTrack Mobile
fittrack-mobile.summary: A comprehensive fitness tracking React Native app with tailored workout plans and detailed analytics.

content.text: The fitness app landscape is incredibly saturated. To stand out, FitTrack needed an interface that felt completely frictionless while navigating mid-workout. We realized that users drop off when applications ask them to manually input too many details with sweaty hands.

We utilized Framer Motion and Zustand to create an optimistic UI architecture. All workout logs are saved instantly to a local cache and synced behind the screens, removing any visible loading spinners during their actual workout.

portfolio-redesign.title: Claude-inspired Portfolio
portfolio-redesign.summary: An interactive, chat-based personal portfolio built to mimic conversational AI interfaces.

content.text: Traditional portfolios can feel like scrolling infinitely down an unresponsive resume. I decided to pivot into an AI-driven interface. By utilizing Next.js app router and Framer Motion, the user is greeted with a sleek command interface that guides them to details gracefully.

hooked-on-movies.title: HookedOnMovies
hooked-on-movies.summary: A high-performance, cinematic movie and TV series discovery platform built with Next.js and TMDB API.

content.text: HookedOnMovies is a high-performance, cinematic movie and TV series discovery platform. It provides users with a seamless interface to explore trending content, view detailed metadata, watch trailers, and discover recommendations. The application focuses on high-quality visuals, fluid animations, and robust SEO.

The platform features a unified discovery engine with intelligent carousels (Swiper.js) and infinite scroll for endless exploration. Detail pages are cinematic and dynamic, adapting layout and metadata based on whether the content is a Movie or a TV show.

Data Normalization: Developed a mapping layer to handle disparate fields from TMDB API (e.g. movies vs TV shows) into a consistent TypeScript interface. Performance: Leveraged Next.js Server Components and parallel fetching with Promise.all to reduce TTFB significantly.

This project demonstrates the ability to handle complex API integrations, build high-performance React applications with TypeScript, and deliver a polished, user-centric design that rivals professional streaming platforms.
